title: OL-20261114-4: test_autorun: no gate card opens because the test depends on live owner-only items
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** foundation tests red on main at 1202e5d (found 2026-11-14 while landing SELF-REFERENCE-1)
**Done check:** grep:tests/foundation/test_autorun.py::owner:rowan
**Status:** closed

test_owner_only_items_open_gate_cards_with_default_and_probe asserts gate_cards is non-empty, which only holds while the live queue has an open owner:rowan item within 8 ticks. Give the test its own owner-only fixture item so it checks the gate-card path, not the state of the backlog.

size: S

**Closing probe:** grep:tests/foundation/test_autorun.py::owner:rowan

**Evidence:** tests/foundation/test_autorun.py OwnerOnlyFixture builds its own owner-only item, so the gate-card path is tested without depending on the live backlog; 14 tests pass.
